name: Paris
notes:
LitArbi 0.9.33-beta “Paris” (build 35) — Sync with the LitArbi Server.
• Signing in now leads straight to your matters. LitArbi offers to copy your matters on the LitArbi Server to this PC and to put this PC's matters on the server, so your Mac and your PCs have the same matters.
• It asks after signing in and after joining another firm's server. It also asks at start and when LitArbi comes back to the front, but only about matters it hasn't asked about before.
• New: File → Sync Matters with the LitArbi Server… and a sync button in the matter overview ask about everything at any time.
• Your own end-to-end encrypted matters open on your other computers without an invitation code.
• Build 34: shared matters on the LitArbi Server, end-to-end encryption, redesigned licence window, per-user install, closing Word during setup.
